properties.developers: Hines in partnership with Urban Street Development
properties.caption: FAT Village is a 5.6-acre mixed-use development anchored by a 180,000-square-foot office building. The $500 million project will include residential units as well as entertainment, retail and public space.
Viceroy Residences Fort Lauderdale is the second-largest project Naftali Group is working on in South Florida. The 45-story tower is in pre-sales with completion expected around 2030.
Ombelle Fort Lauderdale includes two 44-story residential towers spanning 1.6 million square feet. Completion for the 774-unit project is slated for the end of 2028.

Midtown Capital Partners secured an $84 million construction bridge loan to complete Astor Park Flagler Village, a 12-story, two-tower development with 252 residential units and ground-floor retail space.

Flats Flagler Gateway will bring another 12-story residential tower to Flagler Village. CEDARst Companies secured a $68.5 million construction loan for the 350,000-square-foot development, which is expected to wrap mid-2028.

Urbania Flagler 1st Ave is a multifamily development that will include 115 units, 137 parking spaces and 3,875 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The project is projected to finish next year.
